name: Thor
source:
The goddess of the southern sky who governs over summer, and is the second eldest daughter of the 4 goddesses.

Also known as the 『Thunderous God of the Sky』

She governs over military, mining and hunting from within the military country in the south among the forests, Thrudvang. She is known as a goddess who brings bravery and military might, allowing humans to fight evil.

She has the personality of a broadminded warrior.

Although she is the core of and holds immense influence within the military in her country, she herself likes anyone regardless of gender providing they are strong, even to the point of rewarding them.

When the demons invaded, she acknowledges that she would be the one to bear the brunt of the assault, and goes into battle without any hesitation.

「My name is Thor! The God of Thunder, Thor! You luck has run out now that I'm here, and none of you are getting away!」

Wepon names: Mjolnir, Jarngreip

[From [url=http://www.ninetail.tk/tde10/] Ninetail[/url]]
